Usage: tadx capability list [flags]

Shared:
  --config <path> --json --full (details, not rows)
  --environment (--env,-e) <name> (reads: default; writes: sole configured env)

Commands:
  list: List capabilities
    [--all] [--cursor <cursor>] [--domain <domain>] [--limit <1..10000> (default: 20)] [--mutation]
    [--owner <owner>] [--product <product>] [--resource <resource>]
    Filters: AND, case-insensitive; product: substring, others: exact.
    --mutation=true: remote writes; --mutation=false: others; omitted: both.
    --all: complete collection up to 10000; overflow fails.

Rules:
  list: mutually exclusive: --all, --limit
  list: mutually exclusive: --all, --cursor
